decisionsTitle: The checkpoints sit inside the route card, in the document
decisionsSection:
**The owner, 2026-10-14, with a screenshot of the event editor on production:** «Partea cu „Puncte de control” ar trebui să fie băgată în cardul cu traseu (nested)». The card «Puncte de control» stood at the top of the editor's main column, under «De făcut pentru pagina evenimentului» and above «Copiază și tradu tot» and card 1. Amends §757 (the card's forms beside the save form) and §760 point 3 (where the card stands, and the `form`-attribute rework it left to its own change).

**What was there, and why the test did not catch it.** Reproduced on a production build at 1280 and 320 pixels: the card was a sibling of the save form, before it in the document, a level-2 card. That was §760's own decision, not a CSS rule failing in production: a first draft had drawn it under «Traseul» with CSS `order` inside a `display: contents` save form, the adversarial review refused it (the tab key and a screen reader met it before card 1, WCAG 2.4.3 and 1.3.2), and what shipped kept the card above card 1 with a link from «Traseul» («Deschide punctele de control») and a note «deasupra cardului 1». The e2e that went with it measured exactly that placement — above card 1, outside the save form, a level-2 heading — so it was green while the owner saw the card at the top. The owner's ask is the rework §760 named for him.

**Decision — nested in the document.** «Puncte de control» is a named level-3 card of «Traseul» (`#box-course`), its last child after the route's fields and the route description's tabs, closed by default with its line («niciun punct», «2 puncte»); its own cards (each saved point, «Adaugă puncte», the GPX's preview) are level 4. HTML forms cannot nest, and «Traseul» is a card of the event's one save form, so the card's two forms are **detached**, the HTML `form` attribute (option b of the brief): `DetachedActionForm` (`src/shared/forms/DetachedActionForm.tsx`) holds a kept form's state (§315) around the save form, `DetachedForm` is the form's own hidden `<form>` placed right after the save form, never in it, and `DetachedFields` wraps the boxes wherever they are drawn — it recalls what a refusal kept, draws the refusal's summary and a blocked save's notice (§436) right above them, and names the form through a context (`shared/forms/form-owner.tsx`) that the house's primitives read to write `form=` on their own control: `RecallField`, `NeverKeptField`, `RecallHidden`, `RecallCheckbox`, `RecallRadio`, `CheckboxField`, `TimeField` and `SubmitButton` (which also reads the detached form's own pending state, since `useFormStatus` would read the save form's). A plain `<input>` written there (a row's id, the GPX's key) writes `form=` itself. The browser then posts each box with the form it names: «Salvează punctele» and «Adaugă punctele alese» post the points and nothing of the event, «Salvează» posts the event and none of the points (`FormData`, `form.elements`, the browser's validation and the Enter key's default button all follow the attribute, so the save form's readers — the publication check, «Copiază și tradu tot», the preview — never see a checkpoint box). With scripts off each is a plain POST whose refusal comes back in the page with the reason in the card and the typed boxes kept. The kept-form state is one hook shared with `ActionForm` (`useKeptForm`) and the summary one component (`RefusalSummary`), so the two cannot drift. The editor page wraps the save form in `CheckpointForms`; a role that may only read the points gets no forms and the list as words. §760's three objections are answered by construction: the recall comes from the detached form's own provider, no caller threads the attribute through a primitive, and a render test walks every control of the card and fails if one lacks its `form=`.

**What follows.** «Traseul»'s link to the card and its note «deasupra cardului 1» are gone (`Admin.checkpoints.courseNote`, `courseLink`); its closed line still counts the points. «Traseul» folds for every role now, since it holds the card: the Organizer writes the points though not the route (§757's exception to §542), every other role reads them. The card no longer opens itself while empty (a named card is closed until opened, §336); the GPX's preview opens it (`?checkpointsGpx=1`, its own fold open), and a save lands on `#box-checkpoints`, which opens every fold around it. The bib designer's hint names the way there: «adaugă-le în „Traseul” › „Puncte de control”». No CSS `order` anywhere; the `UnderCourse` / `order` machinery of the refused draft never shipped, so there was nothing to remove.

**Refused.** The submit buttons' `formAction` on a card made part of the save form (option a): every press would post the whole event form to the checkpoint actions and the points into the event's save; the save form's `required` boxes (the live event's acknowledgement) would block a checkpoint press unless validation were switched off for it; the save form's confirmation question would intercept it; and a `formAction` bypasses the form's `useActionState`, so a refusal would lose its kept values and its summary. Keeping the card above card 1 with a link: what the owner asked to change.

Not changed: the checkpoint rules, the actions, the audit, the public page, the bib, the event's fields, names and ids. No migration.
changelogLine: - **«Puncte de control» inside «Traseul»** — the event editor's checkpoints card is now a named card of «Traseul», after the route's fields, in the document and on the screen, instead of standing above card 1; its forms post on their own (the HTML `form` attribute), so saving the points never saves the event and «Salvează» never saves a point, with scripts on or off. §NNN.

specsCriteria.text: Amends criterion 135. On the event editor «Puncte de control» (`#box-checkpoints`) is a closed level-3 card inside «Traseul» (`#box-course`), after the route's fields, inside the save form in the document and inside «Traseul»'s box on the screen at 320 and 1280 pixels, with no CSS `order`; its forms' `<form>` elements stand outside the save form and no form is inside another; every box and button of the card names its form with the `form` attribute, so «Salvează» posts no checkpoint field and «Salvează punctele» and «Adaugă punctele alese» post no field of the event; «Traseul» has no link or note sending the reader elsewhere for the points, and its closed line counts them («3 puncte de control») while there are any (2026-10-14, `DECISIONS.md` §NNN).

Amends criteria 123, 124 and 128. From inside «Traseul», a refused save or GPX add keeps what was typed in the card and says the reason above its boxes, with scripts on and with scripts off; the GPX's points are previewed and added, a saved point is changed and one ticked «Scoate» is removed, and none of these presses changes the event's own fields (2026-10-14, `DECISIONS.md` §NNN).
